item.title: Making requests at a hotel
item.description: Ask for things you need at a small guesthouse and get help with simple room problems.

children.definition: The place where people staying in a guesthouse go to ask for help or information.
children.example: Could I pay for my room at reception this evening?

children.definition: An extra blanket you can use if you need one.
children.example: Could you bring me a spare blanket? It gets chilly in my room at night.

children.definition: One more soft cushion to put under your head when you sleep.
children.example: Could I have an extra pillow? One is too low for me.

children.definition: A small bed with high sides for a baby to sleep in.
children.example: Could you put a cot in our room before our baby goes to sleep?

children.definition: The service that cleans guest rooms and puts clean sheets and towels in them.
children.example: Could you ask housekeeping to clean our room while we’re out this afternoon?

children.definition: A small room that moves up and down and takes people to different floors.
children.example: The lift isn’t working. Could you help me take my suitcase upstairs?

children.definition: A device that keeps a room near the temperature you choose.
children.example: Could you show me how to use the thermostat? The room feels too warm.

children.definition: A set of numbers you enter to unlock a room or get into a building.
children.example: Could you write down the door code so I can get into the guesthouse this evening?

children.definition: A strong box with a lock in a guest room where you can keep money or other important things.
children.example: Could you show me how to lock the room safe? I’d like to leave my passport in it.
collocations: put something in the room safe

children.definition: The hole that water goes down when you take a shower.
children.example: Could someone look at the shower drain? The water stays on the floor.

children.definition: An opening or other problem that lets water escape from a pipe or container.
children.example: There’s a leak under the sink in my room. Could someone come and look at it?

children.definition: A small machine that blows warm air to make wet hair dry.
children.example: Could I use a hairdryer? There isn’t one in my room.

children.definition: An arrangement to leave your room after the usual time on your last day.
children.example: Could we have a late checkout tomorrow? Our train doesn’t leave until four.

children.definition: A change from one guest room to another during the same stay.
children.example: Could you arrange a room move? We can hear traffic all night in this room.
